assumptions: runtime/pros/.agents is the SSOT for Pros runtime artifacts.
Existing runtime skills and workflows remain compatible.
Phase 1 includes no new agents; agents are deferred to Phase 2.
All external actions remain drafts until human approval.

tasks.title: Validate Phase 1 structure and naming
acceptance: 17 Phase 1 artifacts are uniquely named
No collisions with existing artifacts
No Phase 1 agents are created

tasks.title: Create shared rules first
acceptance: Privacy and no-PII constraints are documented
Naming/process standards are documented
Human approval requirement is centralized

tasks.title: Create cross-role foundation skills
acceptance: Each skill has SKILL.md, resources, and tests
Outputs are structured Markdown
Negative tests prevent automatic decisions or sending

tasks.title: Create Sachbearbeiter start skills
acceptance: Intake covers admission, rejection, and aftercare
Expose covers evidence-only content and approval workflow
Outputs remain recommendations or drafts

tasks.title: Create recruiter start skills
acceptance: Sourcing creates channel plans and outreach drafts
Matching creates ratings with rationale
Pipeline creates follow-up and priority lists

tasks.title: Create Personalberater start skills
acceptance: Candidate support covers documents, communication, and handoff
Vermittlungsauftrag covers contract, power of attorney, HubSpot, and termination scenarios
Language and legal advice are clearly bounded

tasks.title: Create Phase 1 workflows
acceptance: Each workflow routes to Phase 1 skills
Each workflow states inputs, outputs, escalation points, and exit criteria
Workflows do not duplicate long skill content

tasks.title: Cross-artifact consistency review
acceptance: All References point to local paths
All names match the design
Tests cover simple, medium, exception, and negative cases

alternatives.name: Smaller MVP
alternatives.decision: Rejected: does not make all three roles immediately usable.

alternatives.name: Full design MVP
alternatives.decision: Rejected: too large for a controlled Ultrawork run.
